title: Understand Admin Support Coverage and its limits
summary: Read support context without assuming it grants editing or report-review rights.

sections.title: Read Support Coverage without inferring extra permissions
paragraphs: In the permitted Admin user context, Support Coverage explains why an account appears in the user list. The view is read-only. It shows the account’s support-coverage and Region Scope context where available.
notes: Support Coverage does not grant profile edits, role changes, deletion, User View, resource ownership, organisation/group access, or private notes/files access.
Support-report review is a separate permission. Its current server predicate permits a non-impersonating Super Admin; an Admin coverage assignment does not grant that review capability.
